metadata.support: API precipitation at t is total over preceding hour [t-1h,t)
metadata.role: D1 independent grid proxy, not D0 station or source-slope observation
metadata.quantile_rule: Per relative hour: each of five years has weight 1/5; each eligible sample in year y has weight 1/(5*n_y); inverse ECDF inf{x:F(x)>=p}, no interpolation; all five years required.
metadata.threshold_rule: strictly greater than historical q95; historical years only, never target values
metadata.trajectory_note: Historical same-calendar ±15d trajectories overlap; not independent events or a confidence interval.
metadata.limitations: Reanalysis grid precipitation, terrain-smoothed spatial support; no causal attribution or no-rain-trigger inference.

30d.count_note: wet/zero/exceedance counts refer only to available/assessed hours; missing is never zero
